text:
**Short answer:** the Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro is the best value, and the Nothing Ear (3) has stronger noise cancelling. Prices below come from the search results and may have changed.

## Top picks

**1. Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro: best value, about $120**
- Lists at $149.99. Dealectric tested code **AFSC20** in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, taking the price to **$120**. [Buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro) (affiliate link; Soundcore pays Dealectric a commission at no extra cost to you).
- SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10. Its noise cancelling beat 63% of earbuds tested, and it adds LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- Battery is about 5h 42m per charge with ANC on. The touchscreen case is a gimmick.

**2. Nothing Ear (3): strongest ANC under $150, any phone**
- Just under $150 on Amazon. SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10. It has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IP54 ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours per charge with ANC.

**3. Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro: best for Android, about $134**
- SlashGear says Samsung's official Amazon store sells them new for $134. They have adaptive ANC, IPX7 and up to 18 hours of battery with the case ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

**4. Sony WF-C710N: best budget pick from a major brand, about $119**
- What Hi-Fi? names it its best budget pick. It's listed at $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy and Sweetwater ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)).
- It has Sony's adaptive ANC and about 8.5 hours of battery with ANC on, but no LDAC ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/)).

## Other options
- **iPhone users:** a renewed AirPods Pro 2 can be found around $150 on sale. SlashGear calls their ANC excellent, but "renewed" means you need to vet the seller ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)). The new AirPods 5 are $129, but their open fit blocks less noise ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Cheapest decent ANC:** the Soundcore P31i is $59.99, with adaptive ANC and IP55, though the ANC isn't class-leading ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

## Worth knowing
- Only the Liberty 4 Pro has a direct buy link in my results. For the others, the links above go to the review pages, where you can find retailer links.
- The very best ANC (Bose QuietComfort Ultra Gen 2 at $299, Sony WF-1000XM6) is well over $150, so none of it is in this range.

If you tell me whether you use an iPhone or Android, and whether battery or call quality matters most, I can narrow it to one pick.
